entries.title: Queue tests cannot reach Redis
entries.root_cause: No service is listening on localhost port 6379 when the queue client attempts to connect. Provision Redis on that port for the job.

entries.title: Redis unavailable during worker test
entries.root_cause: No service is listening on localhost port 6379 when the queue client attempts to connect. Provision Redis on that port for the job.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later pull request reaches Redis through a worker fixture and has a different traceback and runner.

entries.title: Queue smoke check cannot connect
entries.root_cause: No service is listening on localhost port 6379 when the queue client attempts to connect. Provision Redis on that port for the job.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A smoke check fails before pytest on a later run, with different installation and checkout output.

entries.title: Redis client uses the wrong port
entries.root_cause: The Redis service is published on host port 6380, while the queue client connects to port 6379. Align the client port with the service mapping.
